title: Connection timeout when ingesting via the REST API
body:
When I push a batch of 5000 records to the ingest endpoint I get:

ERR_CONN_TIMEOUT: connection timed out after 30 seconds
	at com.example.orbit.client.IngestClient.send(IngestClient.java:88)

Small batches work. What setting controls this? See also the slow CSV import question.
author: asker

answers.body:
The default client timeout is 30 seconds. Raise it in `orbit.yaml`:

```yaml
ingest:
  http:
    timeout: 120s
    batchSize: 1000
```

If you use the Java client call `OrbitClient.setTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(120))`.
answers.author: dana

answers.body: In our case the corporate proxy dropped idle connections. Setting `NO_PROXY=orbit.internal` fixed `ERR_CONN_TIMEOUT` for us.
answers.author: li

answers.body: Check the server side `max_request_seconds`; it is 60 by default in Orbit 2.x, so raising the client timeout above 60s does not help.
answers.author: omar
